task.title: Popover gets its own Tab focus trap
task.description: Filed from P6-125 (2026-08-11). Dialog now traps Tab (overlay-stack-gated); Popover deliberately does not — a picker popover open on top of a trapped dialog keeps its own untrapped Tab order, so Tab can walk from popover content into the page. Same mechanism as dialog.rs's trap applies (share the helper), gated the same overlay-stack way; the delete confirm's disposition pickers are the live consumers. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.
